caption: The video captures a static overhead close-up of a round, reflective metallic lid resting on a gray-and-white speckled surface. Inside the dish, a thin pool of clear liquid is dotted with tiny bubbles. A white, fluffy rounded mass sits at the left-center, partly embedded in the liquid and bordered by a curved liquid-film outline that trails right and downward. The rim reflections and textured background hold fixed throughout. The visible change is confined to the white mass, whose lower base region, already translucent and glassy beneath the opaque upper portion, gradually extends downward. The fluffy portion above this clearer zone appears to recede slightly, and the overall bulk looks marginally smaller. The thin curved outline of the surrounding liquid holds roughly fixed, with no clear redistribution around the changing mass. The scattered bubbles remain largely in their original positions, with no new activity clearly visible. The mass continues to settle and clarify, shifting slightly downward without lateral movement across the dish.
